name: Blue Owl Capital Inc.
monetization: Alternative asset manager (~$319B AUM) earning fees on private credit and net-lease capital deployed into AI data centers; majority owner of Meta's Hyperion JV and a Stargate Abilene JV partner.
description_md: Blue Owl Capital is a publicly traded alternative asset manager spanning direct lending, GP strategic capital, and real assets, with AUM of $319B at June 30, 2026. It has become the signature financier of the off-balance-sheet AI data-center structure: its funds own 80% of Meta's Hyperion JV and it anchors the Stargate Abilene project JV alongside Crusoe and Primary Digital Infrastructure.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: earn management fees and net-lease/credit spreads on hyperscaler-backed data-center assets while the tenant's investment-grade lease (rather than Blue Owl's balance sheet) carries the risk. Flagships: 80% of the Hyperion JV ($27B+ senior secured notes via Beignet Investor LLC plus ~$2.5B equity, Meta as sole tenant with a residual-value guarantee); the $15B Stargate Abilene JV with Crusoe and Primary Digital Infrastructure (JPMorgan-led $2.3B and $7.1B construction loans); and an AWS-anchored campus pipeline via its Beale Infrastructure platform (Tucson, AZ). A reported ~$12B Amazon data-center campus commitment appears in press aggregations but is UNVERIFIED against a primary source.
risk_notes_md: Concentration in very large single-tenant AI leases (Meta, OpenAI/Oracle ecosystem) means fee-earning assets and credit performance ride on a handful of hyperscaler counterparties. Recovery values on purpose-built AI campuses if a lease terminates are untested; the Hyperion structure leans on Meta's 16-year residual-value guarantee. Blue Owl showed selectivity by withdrawing from the ~$10B financing for Oracle's Michigan (Saline Township) data center in Dec 2025 — a reminder that private-credit appetite for AI paper is conditional.

events.title: Hyperion JV prices $27.3B senior secured notes
events.why_it_matters: The largest private-placement data-center financing on record; Blue Owl's 80% JV stake makes it the principal off-balance-sheet partner to Meta's biggest capex project.

events.title: Withdraws from ~$10B financing of Oracle's Michigan data center
events.why_it_matters: Oracle shares fell ~5% on the news; the pullback (the deal was later anchored by PIMCO) marked the first visible crack in private-credit appetite for AI project paper.
